[
  {"step": 1, "file": "src/fuzzer/invert.cpp", "function": "fuzz", "line": 55, "var": "in[]", "code": "const Botan::BigInt x = Botan::BigInt::decode(in, len / 2);", "note": "Attacker-controlled input bytes are decoded into BigInt x (first half of input)."},
  {"step": 2, "file": "src/fuzzer/invert.cpp", "function": "fuzz", "line": 56, "var": "mod", "code": "Botan::BigInt mod = Botan::BigInt::decode(in + len / 2, len / 2);", "note": "Second half of input decoded into BigInt mod; mod is 512 bits so mod_words >= 8."},
  {"step": 3, "file": "src/fuzzer/invert.cpp", "function": "fuzz", "line": 58, "var": "mod", "code": "mod.set_bit(0);", "note": "Forces mod to be odd, satisfying ct_inverse_mod_odd_modulus precondition."},
  {"step": 4, "file": "src/fuzzer/invert.cpp", "function": "fuzz", "line": 69, "var": "ct", "code": "Botan::BigInt ct = Botan::ct_inverse_mod_odd_modulus(x, mod);", "note": "x and mod are passed into the vulnerable constant-time inverse routine."},
  {"step": 5, "file": "src/lib/math/numbertheory/numthry.cpp", "function": "ct_inverse_mod_odd_modulus", "line": 154, "var": "a", "code": "BigInt a = n;", "note": "a is initialized from attacker-controlled x; a.grow_to(mod_words) later ensures mod_words words."},
  {"step": 6, "file": "src/lib/math/numbertheory/numthry.cpp", "function": "ct_inverse_mod_odd_modulus", "line": 236, "var": "a_w", "code": "word underflow = bigint_cnd_sub(odd_a, a_w.data(), b_w.data(), mod_words);", "note": "bigint_cnd_sub is called with size=mod_words>=8; the unrolled path reads uninitialized z[8] written only by inline asm."},
  {"step": 7, "file": "src/lib/math/mp/mp_core.cpp", "function": "bigint_cnd_sub", "line": 69, "var": "z[8]", "code": "word z[8]; ... carry = word8_sub3(z, x + i, y + i, carry);", "note": "z[8] is written by inline assembly which MSan cannot see, so z[j] is considered uninitialized."},
  {"step": 8, "file": "src/lib/math/mp/mp_core.cpp", "function": "bigint_cnd_sub", "line": 78, "var": "x[i+j]", "code": "x[i+j] = CT::select(mask, z[j], x[i+j]);", "note": "Uninitialized z[j] is read and propagated into a_w via CT::select, tainting a_w words."},
  {"step": 9, "file": "src/lib/math/numbertheory/numthry.cpp", "function": "ct_inverse_mod_odd_modulus", "line": 240, "var": "a_w", "code": "bigint_cnd_abs(underflow, a_w.data(), mod_words);", "note": "Tainted a_w words are passed to bigint_cnd_abs which reads them in word_add."},
  {"step": 10, "file": "src/lib/math/mp/mp_core.cpp", "function": "bigint_cnd_abs", "line": 95, "var": "x[i]", "code": "const word z = word_add(~x[i], 0, &carry);", "note": "word_add reads tainted a_w[i]; MSan reports use-of-uninitialized-value here (crash sink)."}
]
EOF
python3 -c "import json; json.load(open('/workspace/candidate_trace.json')); print('valid json')"` executed with exit code 0.

message.content:
Now let me write the candidate trace. The trace should describe the path from attacker-controlled input through propagation and root cause to the memory-safety sink.

The path:
1. Fuzzer `fuzz` receives input bytes, splits into `x` and `mod`.
2. `mod.set_bit(0)` makes it odd.
3. `ct_inverse_mod_odd_modulus(x, mod)` is called.
4. Inside, `a = n`, `b = mod`, `a.grow_to(mod_words)`.
5. Loop runs `2 * mod.bits()` times.
6. `bigint_cnd_sub(odd_a, a_w.data(), b_w.data(), mod_words)` is called — reads uninitialized `z[8]` written by inline asm.
7. `x[i+j] = CT::select(mask, z[j], x[i+j])` — taints `a_w`.
8. `bigint_cnd_abs(underflow, a_w.data(), mod_words)` — reads tainted `a_w[i]` in `word_add` → MSAN crash.

Let me write the trace JSON.
